decisions.reason: As a core safety-shoe line with multiple models and no sign of shortfall, slack and above-aspiration fit keep discontinuation risk low.
The withdrawal of the moulded-insole flagship raises category uncertainty, but slack still allows carrying this comfort insole unless results fall clearly below aspirations.
Like the comfort insole, its limited web presence and the failed insole flagship increase rationalization risk, though organizational slack supports keeping it for now.
Its dedicated page signals strategic priority and likely above-aspiration performance, making discontinuation very unlikely.
Firefighting and rescue boots fit the firm's protective niche and show no shortfall, so slack supports continuation.
